newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Arafat says ready to help end Sri Lanka rebel war.
newsitem.headline: Arafat says ready to help end Sri Lanka rebel war.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat offered on Monday to help negotiate an end to Sri Lanka's 13-year-old ethnic war.
"I am under your disposal and will put all my efforts to help achieve a settlement," Arafat said at a public meeting in the Sri Lankan capital of Colombo.
"I am making the offer officially now," he said.
Majority sinhalese Sri Lanka is fighting a war against Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam who demand a separate homeland in the island's north and east for the minority Tamils.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the conflict. The LTTE says the number is higher.
The Sri Lankan government in the past has declined all offers for the third party mediation to end the war, saying it was the country's internal matter.
